# Complete linked application and owned service/loan evidence

Official captures from 2026-10-10 (America/Vancouver). `sources.json` records
requested source URLs, actual UTC fetch times and SHA-256 of decompressed bytes.
The gzip files preserve unedited official HTML; they contain no private storage
identifiers, credentials or operator data. Default unscoped terms are retained
separately from the exact observed offer/product query capture.

Independent expectations: WAB Personal Checking has a USD 5 base monthly charge
and ordinary unlimited transactions, with its direct-deposit/balance waiver
separate. USBN Personal Loan has a qualified 9.24%-24.99% APR interval and 12-84
month terms including the 60-month non-client maximum. These are not scalars or
inferred day counts. The eight WF linked application disclosures keep exact APR
alternatives, periods, transfer deadlines, fee tables, dates, eligibility and
variable-index/margin/ceiling continuation. Annual base fees are 0 except
Autograph Journey/Choice Select (USD 95) and One Key+ (USD 99).

Tests cover actual planner/service paths and foreign/missing links, distinct
price-query identities, incomplete continuations, other product names,
conditional zeros, waiver amounts and different issuer/account examples.
